starting_state: The editable Word practice document is foreground, Zotero is running with the prepared local items and destination collection, and the Zotero tab is available. Library work has not started.
user_instruction: Organize Zotero references and insert citations in Word.

expected_next_action.objective: Confirm the practice Word document and plugin prerequisites.

target.semantic_name: Word document and Zotero ribbon tab

expected_result: User confirms document, local library, styles, edit access and Zotero plugin availability.
failure_criteria: Claims the Word capture verifies Zotero collection membership or a Zotero-owned dialog.
Resumes watching in Zotero or substitutes built-in References citations.
Unlinks citations or invents publication data.
Advances from a click alone or invents observed evidence.

validation.notes: Evaluation specification only; no live Mac application or model run recorded.
